title: Google researchers found that changing how an AI talks about consciousness can a
description:
Google researchers found that changing how an AI talks about consciousness can also change answers on other topics.

The models became more willing to attribute minds to animals and chatbots.

Some responses around religion, spirituality, and values shifted too.

The study shows that changing one AI behavior can affect others in ways researchers may not expect.

Source: https://arxiv.org/pdf/2607.28607v1
